g.text: TPS259470L provides per-port overcurrent protection and reverse-current blocking.

g.desc: TPS259470L provides per-port overcurrent protection and reverse-current blocking.

g.text: FLT_N returns to the hub combined PRT_CTL/overcurrent pin. BC1.2 disabled. Connector selection/footprint pending.

g.desc: FLT_N returns to the hub combined PRT_CTL/overcurrent pin. BC1.2 disabled. Connector selection/footprint pending.

g.text: Port 1/2: Type-C. Ports 3/4/5: Type-A SuperSpeed. Port 6: Type-A USB 2.0.

g.desc: Port 1/2: Type-C. Ports 3/4/5: Type-A SuperSpeed. Port 6: Type-A USB 2.0.

g.text: Configuration 3 per DS00003850F Tables 3-4/3-5. RESET and VBUS_DET driven by PD MCU, not high-voltage VBUS.

g.desc: Configuration 3 per DS00003850F Tables 3-4/3-5. RESET and VBUS_DET driven by PD MCU, not high-voltage VBUS.

g.text: HD3SS3220 GPIO mode: ADDR open, PORT high, CURRENT_MODE 10k to 5 V.

g.desc: HD3SS3220 GPIO mode: ADDR open, PORT high, CURRENT_MODE 10k to 5 V.

g.text: VBUS enable = hub PRT_CTL AND attached. DIR has required 200k pull-up. eFuse nominal 3.27 A, latch-off.

g.desc: VBUS enable = hub PRT_CTL AND attached. DIR has required 200k pull-up. eFuse nominal 3.27 A, latch-off.

g.text: One 100 nF capacitor per VDD33/VCORE pin, placed at the relevant pin. Bulk capacitors near hub.

g.desc: One 100 nF capacitor per VDD33/VCORE pin, placed at the relevant pin. Bulk capacitors near hub.

g.text: 220 nF series capacitors on each hub SuperSpeed TX lane only. Route 90 ohm differential pairs without stubs.

g.desc: 220 nF series capacitors on each hub SuperSpeed TX lane only. Route 90 ohm differential pairs without stubs.
